checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Small freestanding chalkboard standing on pavement outside the café
must.why: A black A-frame board with wooden frame stands on the pavement left of the door.

must.item: Reads exactly 'COFFEE TO GO', all words legible
must.why: COFFEE is readable, but the lower lines look like 'TO' and a garbled 'GO' that reads as 'CLT' or 'CU'. The text is small and unclear.

must.item: Words lie on the sign surface with matching perspective
must.why: The text sits on the board face with similar tilt and looks painted on, not overlaid.

must.item: Plausible ground contact, scale, lighting and shadow
must.why: Scale and contact are fair, but the shadow is weak. The board covers most of the plant and part of a chair, so it looks crowded.

must.item: Original storefront, awning, tables and wide composition intact
must.why: The framing and awning are kept, but the plant is mostly hidden and the left chair is partly covered. The image also looks slightly regenerated.

exact_text.read_as: COFFEE / TO / GO, with the last line garbled and reading like 'CLT'

faults.what: Chalk lettering of 'TO GO' is garbled and not clearly legible at this size
The sign covers the potted plant and part of the left chair, which changes the original scene
The shadow is faint, and the board looks pasted in beside the table
The image looks slightly regenerated overall, e.g. a sharper awning and altered details

summary: A believable A-frame chalkboard was added, but "TO GO" is garbled, and the board hides the plant and part of a chair, so it needs a redo.
